> Let us focus on downward motion (fall from h) with $x$ being the distance fallen

>

> Option B: the speed increases at increasing rate as it falls (slope of tangent gets steeper as ‘h’ decreases)

>

> Option C: speed increases linearly

>

> Option D: it increases at decreasing rate

>

> The key is to find the relationship between $v - x$ which is $v = \sqrt{2gx}$

>

> $\frac{dv}{dx}\  \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}$ or the velocity will keep increasing at decreasing rate (increase in speed for a unit fall will keep decreasing as it falls)
